description: Four inputs run into eight difference rectifiers, each rectifier giving the positive half of one grouping on the left of the panel and the negative half on the right

inputs.text: One of the four signals mixed into the eight rectifiers; the coloured dot beside this jack is the colour that stands for it in the groupings printed by the output jacks

notes: nothing here makes a signal of its own: with no cables in the four inputs every one of the sixteen outputs is at 0V.
the dots beside each output name its grouping by colour, and the slash separates the plus side from the minus side: magenta is input 1, blue input 2, yellow input 3, green input 4.
the maker's tooltips name the four inputs custard, treacle, natto and batter, in that order from the top.
